description:
“You’re not the only mad dog around here. I’m Musim, the Unbothered One of Pildong’s Book Alley!”
— Musim, Joseon’s greatest erotic fiction writer

“If that’s what you desire, then the one who survives should become king.”
— Myeong, the ill-fated Grand Prince

“Just you wait. I, Master Geobong Musim, have a feeling I’m about to create the masterpiece of a lifetime.”

Musim was the only woman working at Gyeongdeok Bookshop.

But she had another profession as well: she was none other than Master Geobong, Joseon’s greatest erotic fiction writer.

One day, while brainstorming ideas for her next work as usual, Musim happened upon a man with an impressively toned physique. Inspired by his body, she created Ssanghwajeom, the masterpiece of her lifetime.

Ssanghwajeom became a sensation that shook Joseon to its core, captivating people from every walk of life. Musim had finally achieved her dream and was supposed to live happily ever after…

Or so she thought.

A good-for-nothing pretty boy barged into her life, sending it spiraling in a direction she could never have imagined.

“MY BOOK! WHERE’S MY BOOK?! GIVE IT BACK, YOU THIEF!!!”

“Now, now. Have you forgotten that your book is in my hands?”

And it turned out that this pretty-faced nuisance was a Grand Prince.

Meanwhile, Hyehwa, Joseon’s greatest courtesan, comes looking for Musim and presents her with a suspiciously sweet offer.

The one book Musim wrote just for fun is about to turn her life upside down…
